title: Remembered alignment, spacing and text controls
summary: Arrange selected objects and justify their text from upper-right split buttons that remember your choices.

Added: Seven object alignment actions, including centering both axes, and four horizontal/vertical distribution actions for equal centers or equal gaps.
Nine text justification combinations, including center/middle, applied together to selected text-capable objects while preserving their individual labels.
Dropdown choices apply immediately and become the main button's displayed icon and label. Click the main button to repeat that action on another selection.
Alignment, distribution and text choices are saved independently in local preferences across app restarts. Inapplicable actions are disabled.
Verified: Native callout alignment, equal vertical gaps, centered and bottom-right text, one-step Undo, editable save and 256000 clipboard pixels passed on synthetic content.
Engine checks cover all alignment/distribution actions, fractional coordinates, invalid inputs, persistence, no-op history and atomic preference storage.
Bounds algorithms adapt audited MIT DesignCraft code; ClipCraft document commands and UI remain independent.

limitations: Alignment uses selected object bounds, including callout pointers. Key-object/page alignment, persistent groups and group rotation remain unfinished.
Text entry still uses the existing dialog. Inline centered text and shape text, reusable templates beyond arrows, crisp vector zoom, editable autosave and toolbar ordering remain priority work.
Middle-button panning passes input tests but still needs a physical held-middle-button drag check. It has no Ready claim.
This unsigned historical alpha covers only the workflows verified in its release notes.
